items.title: Workday beats quarterly estimates as subscription revenue outlook broadly matches forecasts
items.summary: Workday (NASDAQ:WDAY) reported quarterly revenue and adjusted earnings above analyst expectations while providing a third-quarter subscription revenue forecast broadly in line with consensus estimates. The company’s shares initially declined in extended trading following the results before reversing direction to trade slightly higher.
